boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named cultural and civic destinations on corridors immediately around Washington Square and NYU.

cards.title: Fifth Avenue: Washington Square Arch
cards.subtitle: On Fifth Avenue at Washington Square North, beside Washington Square Park
cards.notes: Enter the park from Fifth Avenue and look up at the marble arch; use it as a clear landmark before continuing through the square.
cards.short_summary: A marble gateway at the north edge of Washington Square Park.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks identifies the Washington Square Arch as a feature of Washington Square Park.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park feature; follow NYC Parks rules and posted conditions.

cards.title: Washington Square South: Judson Memorial Church
cards.subtitle: On Washington Square South at 55 Washington Square South
cards.notes: Walk the south side of the square to see the church façade, then check Judson’s calendar for public services and community programs.
cards.short_summary: A church and community venue directly on the square’s south edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Judson lists its address as 55 Washington Square South and publishes in-person services there.
cards.access_notes: Service and event access varies; consult the calendar before attending.

cards.entity_name: NYU Skirball Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: LaGuardia Place: NYU Skirball Center
cards.subtitle: On LaGuardia Place, between West 3rd and West 4th Streets
cards.notes: Use LaGuardia Place to find the Skirball entrance, then consult its program for performances and box-office details before planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: NYU’s performing-arts venue at the base of Kimmel Center.
cards.evidence_claim: NYU Skirball states that its main entrance is at 566 LaGuardia Place, between West 3rd and West 4th Streets.
cards.access_notes: Box-office and performance access vary by date; check the venue’s current listing.

cards.title: Sixth Avenue: IFC Center
cards.subtitle: On Sixth Avenue at West 3rd Street, near Washington Square
cards.notes: Find the theater at the West 3rd Street corner and review the current program for screenings, accessibility options, and ticket information.
cards.short_summary: A year-round cinema at the Sixth Avenue and West 3rd Street corner.
cards.evidence_claim: IFC Center says it is located at 323 Avenue of the Americas (Sixth Avenue) at West 3rd Street and is open year-round.
cards.access_notes: Screenings require tickets; check current showtimes and accessibility information.

cards.title: Sixth Avenue: Jefferson Market Library
cards.subtitle: On Sixth Avenue at 10th Street, north of NYU’s Washington Square campus
cards.notes: Pause at the former courthouse tower, then use the library’s location page to confirm current opening times and services before entering.
cards.short_summary: A New York Public Library branch in the landmark former courthouse.
cards.evidence_claim: The New York Public Library lists Jefferson Market Library at 425 Avenue of the Americas and describes its historic courthouse setting.
cards.source_title: Jefferson Market Library — The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Check the branch page for current hours, programs, and entry information.

cards.title: East 4th Street: La MaMa
cards.subtitle: On East 4th Street between Bowery and Second Avenue
cards.notes: Follow East 4th Street to La MaMa’s theaters and review its calendar for current performances, workshops, and ticket details.
cards.short_summary: An experimental-theater organization with venues on East 4th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: La MaMa lists its Ellen Stewart Theatre and The Downstairs at 66 East 4th Street, between Bowery and Second Avenue.
cards.source_title: Visit — La MaMa Experimental Theatre Club
cards.access_notes: Performance access and ticket requirements vary by event.

cards.title: East 4th Street: Merchant's House Museum
cards.subtitle: On East 4th Street at 29 East 4th Street, west of Bowery
cards.notes: Approach from the East 4th Street sidewalk and consult the museum’s visit page for current tours, timed-entry information, and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: A preserved nineteenth-century house museum on East 4th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Merchant's House Museum lists its location as 29 East 4th Street in Manhattan.
cards.access_notes: Museum entry is by its current admissions and tour policies.

cards.title: Lafayette Street: The Public Theater
cards.subtitle: On Lafayette Street at 425 Lafayette Street, near Astor Place
cards.notes: Walk Lafayette Street to the former Astor Library building and check The Public’s schedule for performances, talks, and ticket availability.
cards.short_summary: A theater organization based in the former Astor Library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Public Theater lists its downtown home at 425 Lafayette Street, between Astor Place and East 4th Street.
cards.access_notes: Event access and ticket requirements vary by production.

cards.title: Cooper Square: Grey Art Museum
cards.subtitle: On Cooper Square at 18 Cooper Square, east of Washington Square
cards.notes: Use the Cooper Square entrance to reach NYU’s art museum, then review the exhibition page for current galleries and visitor guidance.
cards.short_summary: NYU’s university art museum at Cooper Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Grey Art Museum lists its location at 18 Cooper Square and presents exhibitions from NYU’s art museum.
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s visit page for current gallery hours and visitor policies.

cards.title: West Houston Street: Film Forum
cards.subtitle: On West Houston Street at 209 West Houston Street, west of Sixth Avenue
cards.notes: Follow West Houston Street to Film Forum and use its current schedule to choose a screening, checking ticket and accessibility information first.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit cinema on West Houston Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Film Forum lists its address as 209 West Houston Street, New York, NY 10014.
cards.access_notes: Screenings require tickets; consult the current schedule before visiting.
